name: design.norwichwebsite/spacemail
title: Spacemail by NWD
description: Check, search, read and draft replies to Spacemail (Spaceship) emails, across several mailboxes.

environmentVariables.name: SPACEMAIL_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Your Spacemail address. For more mailboxes use SPACEMAIL_1_EMAIL, SPACEMAIL_2_EMAIL and so on.

environmentVariables.name: SPACEMAIL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: The mailbox password (not your Spaceship account password).

environmentVariables.name: SPACEMAIL_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: A short nickname for the mailbox, e.g. Support.

environmentVariables.name: SPACEMAIL_ALLOW_SEND
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to let Claude send emails. Off by default, so replies are saved as drafts.
